title: a non-empty Codex AGENTS.override.md is skipped with a warning, an empty one is not
source: intended: docs/decisions.md D8 (setup instructions, defect N-18): a delimited, reversible JITSO block in the instruction files agents read
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-18, setup instructions). Codex reads `AGENTS.override.md` instead of `AGENTS.md` when it has content. With one that does, `--scope user` warns on stderr (naming `AGENTS.override.md`), does not create `~/.codex/AGENTS.md`, and still writes `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md`.

stderr.equals: jitso: warning: ~/.codex/AGENTS.override.md is not empty, so Codex reads it instead of AGENTS.md; the JITSO block was not written to ~/.codex/AGENTS.md
